title: Avoid (\b|\B) alternation in regexes used on untrusted/large text
answers: Logs panel freezes/hangs the browser on long lines
Prism tokenization is slow or blocks the main thread
Why does highlighting a long unassigned string take seconds?
body:
Symptom: The logs panel's main thread blocks for hundreds of ms to seconds when tokenizing a long string that has no '=' (e.g. a 16KB unassigned value).
Root cause: public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts log-token-key regex used (\b|\B)[\w_]+(?=\s*=) — matching at every position (both boundary types) forces the (?=\s*=) lookahead to be retried at every character of long non-matching words, causing quadratic backtracking.
Fix pattern: Replace (\b|\B) alternation with a single anchor (\b) when the token you're matching can only legitimately start at a word boundary; this collapses the number of lookahead attempts from O(n) per position to O(1) per boundary.
Constraints: Applies to any Prism/grammar regex run on user-controlled or unbounded-length log/text content with a trailing lookahead; does not apply where matches genuinely need to start mid-word (non-boundary) — verify with a benchmark on a long non-matching string before/after.
applies: Prism grammar regexes in public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts and similar highlighting grammars processing arbitrary log text

The logs panel grammar.ts logsGrammar regex used (\b|\B)[\w_]+(?=\s*=), which blocked the main thread for hundreds of milliseconds when tokenizing 16KB strings without '=' due to O(n) per-position lookahead attempts; replacing (\b|\B) with (\b) collapses this to O(1) per boundary. This applies to Prism grammars in public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts and similar highlighting grammars that process user-controlled or unbounded-length text; verify the fix with a benchmark on a long non-matching string before and after, and do not apply if matches genuinely need to start mid-word.
